If an Abbot gives a Sabbat vampire "+1 intercept against (D) actions
directed at his or her controller" does this include actions directed
against anything that the controller controls such as vampires,
locations, and equipment.

This came up in a game.

Messages.Author: Oortje
Messages.Body:


minions, or on an Arson targetting your Parthenon. Any action that
targets a card controlled by a Methuselah also targets that

Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:


Any action which targets something controlled by another player is a
(D) action. LSJ has said so before.

There is a hierarchy of targets. Methuselah is at the top and if you
target anything "lower" you are also targeting the Methuselah.

If you target a Retainer/Equipment, you target the Methuselah (but not
necessarily the Minion with the Retainer).
If you target a Location, you target the Methuselah (but not a Minion,
Retainer etc. e.g. Burning Secure Haven)
If you target a Player's Pool, you target the Methuselah.

If you call a Political Action, you take an undirected action that
will affect other Methuselahs. e.g. KRC is not directed but it
affects Methuselahs.
